contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Theodosius (379-395), Victory left, Reece period 21, issue of 388-395. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right, seen from front. Obverse inscription: FL MAX[---] AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing left. Reverse inscription: [blundered] VICTORIA AVGG. Diameter: 14.3mm, Weight: 1.38gms, die axis: 6
